purpose: Separate the dietary purine-precursor ledger from the endogenous luminal-urate ledger, then identify the conditions under which spatial UOX-to-PDB staging outperforms overlapping access to the same urate pool. No serum-urate efficacy is computed.
interpretation_policy: Fractions of grid cells are design-space occupancy, not biological probabilities. Dietary and endogenous ledgers are never summed into a serum-urate effect.
